blocks.content: Let's start by reviewing the formula for filling the cell DP[i, w]:
max( DP[i-1, w], ( DP[i-1, w - w(i)] + P(i) ) )
This formula chooses the max value among two components:

rows: The profit when the current item is not included in the knapsack., i.e., when we simply copy the value from the row above.

The sum of DP[i-1, w - w(i)] and P(i).

Here, P(i) is the value of the current item.

And, DP[i-1, w - w(i)] is the optimum value from the first i-1 items (i.e., the previous items) that fits in the space left after adding the current item (i.e., item i).

blocks.content: Just reading the descriptions of these components might not be sufficient to understand the formula. So, let's locate them in our DP table next.
